steps.title: implement repeated imports and immutable originals
steps.work: support pasted text, notes and file batches; assign course/source labels; retain originals, checksums and import jobs; detect duplicates and updated versions.
steps.source_checks: repeated/batch imports; duplicate detection without deleting updates; cancellation; unsupported/oversized/corrupt file handling; originals unchanged. Audit and checkpoint.

steps.title: implement text-native PDF, DOCX, and EPUB extraction

steps.title: implement correction, local embeddings and derivative invalidation
steps.work: present original beside extracted text; allow corrections; version the extraction; chunk approved course text and create a local semantic-embedding index keyed to course, source, extraction and model versions; mark affected activities and vectors stale when source meaning changes.
steps.deliverables: verified content pipeline with a pinned, locally executed embedding model and versioned course-scoped semantic index.
steps.source_checks: corrections persist; old versions traceable; affected derivatives and vectors marked stale then rebuilt; unaffected data retained; cross-course isolation; model/version metadata; retrieval known-answer evaluation; offline execution; all import-format regression and interrupted-import scenarios. Audit and checkpoint.
